rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization Ordinance Coverage
rules.requirement: Berkeley's rent control (rent stabilization) applies to most pre-1980 multifamily units, certain single-family homes, and rooming houses, but not to new construction completed after June 1980, most condos, or certain subsidized/owner-occupied units.
rules.coverage_conditions: Multifamily units built before 1980; rooming houses; single-family homes with tenancies beginning before 1996 are fully covered (rent control applies). New construction after June 1980, post-1996 single-family tenancies, most condos, and certain subsidized units are only partially covered (no rent control).
rules.exemptions: Golden Duplex units, owner-occupant shared kitchen/bath units, certain ADU tenancies, university dormitories, and nonprofit cooperatives are fully exempt from rent control.
rules.quoted_span: New construction: units that were built and received a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980**

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the unit is a rooming house, condominium, ADU, government-subsidized unit, Golden Duplex, or nonprofit cooperative

rules.conflict_note: Table lists 'built before 1980' for full coverage but 'after June 1980' for new-construction exemption, creating a slight date ambiguity between calendar year 1980 cutoffs.

rules.title: Berkeley Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance Coverage
rules.requirement: Most Berkeley rental units, including new construction, condos, and subsidized housing, are covered by the city's just cause eviction protections, but certain owner-occupied, shared-living, ADU, university, and cooperative units are exempt.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies broadly to multifamily units, single-family homes, rooming houses, new construction, condominiums, and most subsidized housing regardless of build date.
rules.exemptions: Golden Duplex units (owner-occupied since 1979), units where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant since the start of tenancy, certain post-2018 ADU tenancies with owner-occupancy, university dormitories, and nonprofit cooperatives are exempt from just cause protections.
rules.quoted_span: Unit where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant if the owner lived on the property at the time the tenancy started

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the owner shares a kitchen/bath with the tenant, whether the unit is an ADU in an owner-occupied property, whether the unit is a university dormitory, or whether it is a nonprofit cooperative
